ops.title: DER entitlements (op-16) measurements for P1c: grammar, absent-blob, status-word bits
ops.body:
Measured on macOS 26.5.2 with the OpenClaw Developer ID cert (codesign's own DER encoder = what AMFI
emits). Resolves SPEC-P1c OQ1/OQ2/OQ3. Sample real blob saved at cut/p1/sample-der-entitlements.bin
(no secrets -- just an entitlements structure) for the parser to test against.

OQ2 -- THE op-16 DER GRAMMAR (pin the parser to this):
  [APPLICATION 16] (tag 0x70, constructed) {
    INTEGER            -- version, value 1 (verify == 1)
    [CONTEXT 16] (tag 0xb0, constructed) {   -- the entitlements dictionary
      SEQUENCE { UTF8String key, <value> }   -- one per entitlement, repeated
      ...
    }
  }
  Values seen: BOOLEAN (0x01 0x01 0xFF/0x00), and SEQUENCE (array -> a SEQUENCE of element values,
  e.g. UTF8Strings for app-groups). Scalars (INTEGER, UTF8String) follow standard DER. Keys are
  UTF8String. The parser must: unwrap [APPLICATION 16], check version INTEGER==1, enter [CONTEXT 16],
  iterate key-value SEQUENCEs, match keys. Reject duplicate keys; bound depth; clamp to the blob's
  own length header (op-16 returns an 8-byte blob header magic 0xfade7172 + length, then this DER).
  Use stdlib encoding/asn1 (NOT a third-party parser); the APPLICATION/CONTEXT tags need explicit
  asn1.RawValue / class+tag handling.

OQ1 -- ABSENT DER BLOB: a Developer ID binary signed with NO entitlements returns op-16 rc=0 with
  magic=0x00000000, len=0 (EMPTY), NOT a 0xfade7172 blob (op-7 XML likewise empty). So the parser
  treats "magic != 0xfade7172" (including all-zero) as "no DER entitlements present -> vacuously
  passes the six injection rejections; hard-fail only RequiredEntitlements/RequiredAppGroup." Modern
  codesign emits BOTH op-7 (0xfade7171) and op-16 (0xfade7172) whenever entitlements are present
  (confirmed on the entitled fixtures), so "XML-only, no DER" arises only from old/hand-crafted
  signatures -- a narrow named limitation; T1's CS_OPS_BLOB read gives a CD-bound handle on it since
  the superblob carries both entitlement slots. Do NOT read op-7 as a fallback (SPEC-P1c 10).

OQ3 -- STATUS-WORD ENTITLEMENT BITS: allow-unsigned-executable-memory + disable-executable-page-
  protection clear CS_HARD (0x100) AND CS_ENFORCEMENT (0x1000): measured STATUS 0x22010211 vs clean
  0x22011311. csposture.Check ALREADY denies both (lines 57-62), so entitlement-level rejection of
  these two is REDUNDANT with the status floor -- confirms the design-review clause audit. G3's audit
  needs only TWO rows: allow-jit and allow-dyld-environment-variables (the ONLY injection
  entitlements invisible in the status word -- measured: an allow-jit binary reports STATUS
  0x22011311, bit-identical to a clean hardened-runtime binary). `AllowUnsignedExecutableMemory` as a
  Requirement field buys nothing.
